Subject: Proposal: SOC 2 Type II retainer + scope for 2027 renewal

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a baseline SOW and fee schedule for the SOC 2 Type II retainer covering 2027–2028. Highlights: 
- Single engagement covering in-scope prod services (prod-redwood-api, prod-analytics), plus optional infra subscope for Dedicated deployments.
- Estimated testing window: Oct 17–Nov 4, 2027 (we can shift by +/- 2 weeks).
- Base fee: $78,000 (annual retainer) with a 10% discount if signed for 2 years.
- Net30 payment by default; we can discuss net45/60 per procurement needs.

Attachments: [ControlComms_SOW_v1.pdf] [ControlComms_fee_schedule_2027.xlsx]

Questions for you: can you confirm the canonical list of services to include in the scope and whether Redwood wants the optional Dedicated infra included in the baseline? Also, any procurement constraints on payment terms?

Happy to hop on a 20m sync if helpful.

Best,
Marisa Cole
Principal, ControlComms LLC

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SOC 2 Type II retainer + scope for 2027 renewal

Marisa — thanks for the proposal and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications before we push to procurement/legal: 

1) Scope: please limit the baseline SOW to the production-facing services only: prod-redwood-api, prod-console, and prod-redis-cache clusters. We do not want optional Dedicated infra (per-customer) in the baseline — that can be an add-on.

2) Deliverables: please include a short list of evidence items you will request and the timeline for evidence collection. Last year we had several ad hoc data requests that stretched the schedule.

3) Payment terms: procurement prefers net45 or net60 on retainer work; finance may need net45 for prepayment of travel. Can you confirm what ControlComms can accept as a firm position?

4) Discounts: the 2-year discount sounds reasonable; please call out termination language for multi-year agreements.

Cc'ing Monica to take this into procurement review and Laura for security scope confirmation. Monica — can you start a procurement ticket and list any required clauses (DPA/KMS handling, subprocessor list, insurance limits)?

Vivek
VP, Product & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek/Marisa — I opened procurement ticket PROC-788 (link below) and started an initial pass on commercial redlines. Key points from procurement/legal lens: 

- Payment: Redwood prefers Net60 for consulting retainers; we can do Net45 if vendor accepts it as final. Please confirm vendor flexibility.
- PO vs. Master Agreement: we prefer a Master Services Agreement + SOW structure. Add a clause that SOWs are governed by the MSA to avoid repeated redlines.
- Data Handling + DPA: we need explicit mention of storage locations, access controls, and a standard DPA. Add KMS/HSM handling requirements for keys used to encrypt logs/evidence.
- Insurance & liability: require $5M umbrella and cyber liability; please confirm.
- Termination: for multi-year pricing, include a 90-day out clause with prorated refund.

Attachments for procurement: [procurement_checklist.pdf] (attached to ticket), summary of required clauses in the ticket.

Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
